title: Operator Learning for Predicting Bulk Wave Parameters of Spectral Wave Models
abstract: arXiv:2604.06433v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The impact of wave-induced forcing on the mean water level and nearshore currents is typically modeled through excess momentum fluxes, also known as radiation stresses, and their spatial gradients. Accurate storm surge prediction requires coupled circulation and wave models, but the high computational cost of numerical wave models limits their temporal resolution. In this work, we explore a proof-of-concept application of Deep Operator Networks (DeepONets) as a surrogate for the Simulating WAves Nearshore (SWAN) numerical wave model. Unlike grid-dependent surrogate models, DeepONets learn the underlying continuous operator, and thus, can provide highly efficient prediction while enabling discretization-invariant inference. The proposed surrogate model is evaluated using two distinct 1-D and 2-D steady-state numerical examples with variable boundary wave conditions and wind fields. translated_title: 用于预测谱波浪模型整体波浪参数的算子学习
translated_abstract: 波浪诱导强迫对平均水位和近岸流的影响通常通过剩余动量通量（也称为辐射应力）及其空间梯度来建模。准确的风暴潮预测需要环流模型与波浪模型的耦合，但数值波浪模型高昂的计算成本限制了其时间分辨率。在本工作中，我们探索了将深度算子网络作为近岸海浪数值模拟模型（SWAN）代理模型的概念验证应用。与依赖网格的代理模型不同，DeepONet学习潜在的连续算子，因此能够在实现与离散化无关的推理的同时提供高效的预测。所提出的代理模型通过两个具有可变边界波浪条件和风场的一维与二维稳态数值算例进行了评估。当应用于实际数值算例时……
tldr: 该研究提出将深度算子网络作为SWAN谱波浪模型的高效代理模型，学习连续算子以实现与网格离散化无关的整体波浪参数快速预测，从而降低耦合风暴潮模拟的计算成本。
en_tdlr: This study proposes Deep Operator Networks (DeepONets) as efficient, discretization-invariant surrogates for the SWAN spectral wave model, enabling rapid prediction of bulk wave parameters at low computational cost for coupled storm surge simulations.
